page.overview:
Who is Errevon?

Two years after the end of the Scattered War, Errevon and his elemental army invaded Tal'Dorei from the Frostfell, the Elemental Plane of Ice, via a portal in the forest now called the Frostweald. Skysunder, Herald of the Rimelord, was a white dragon who had been sealed within the Frostfell. At some time prior to or concurrent with the Scattered War, Skysunder began acting as a scout to Errevon in order to find the weakest points between the planes. It was with her help that, two years into the reign of Sovereign Zan Tal'Dorei in the new Tal'Dorei Empire, Errevon opened a portal in the forest now known as the Frostweald and plunged Tal'Dorei into a perpetual winter known as the Icelost Years. Errevon then constructed a citadel of ice in the Foramere Basin.

After several years, the Tal'Dorei Council was finally able to convince both Syngorn and Kraghammer—who had been on opposing sides in the Scattered War—to ally with them and fight back the invasion. Together, the peoples of Tal'Dorei and with Ashari druids of Zephrah were able to push Errevon and his servants back into the Frostfell. The Ashari permanently closed the rift between planes, and the storm then quickly subsided, leaving some weaker spirits as the only remains of the Rimelord's army.
